name: Yearly ZCTA-Level Stratified Counts
description: Yearly ZCTA-level hospitalizations and mortality counts stratified by age group, sex, race, and eligibility.

content.year: Int64: Calendar year of the data
content.age_grp: String: Age group category of beneficiaries
content.sex: Int32: Sex of the beneficiary (0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female)
content.race: Int32: Race code of the beneficiary
content.race_rti: Int32: RTI race code of the beneficiary
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status (1 = dual-eligible, 0 = not eligible)
content.buyin: Int32: State buy-in status (1 = yes, 0 = no state buy-in)
